statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I47.1 was used
The diagnosis code I34.0 was used
The service was to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
